description:
ADR-0006 (docs/adr/0006-public-api-surface.md, rename item 6) marks Defk.arg_vars/1 as a hidden internal helper that should not live on the user-facing Defk module. Today it is a public def with @doc false in lib/defk.ex (around line 445), called from lib/defk.ex (two places in the generated wrappers) and from lib/defk/elixir_mode.ex:147.

Move it to an internal module (an existing internal one that fits, e.g. where the other signature helpers live, or a small Defk.Internal-style module with @moduledoc false), update the three callers, and leave no arg_vars on Defk. Generated code calls it at compile time only, so compiled user modules don't reference Defk.arg_vars at run time; check that with rg over the generated code paths and record it.

Done when Defk exports no arg_vars/1, the callers use the new home, mix ci passes, and test/docs_checks_test.exs (public @doc check) stays green. Update ADR-0006's row to note it was done (Consequences or the rename list), without rewriting the decision.
title: Move Defk.arg_vars/1 out of the user-facing Defk module
